part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in the page reverse index used by `Site.GetPage`'s simple-name lookup (`hugolib/content_map_page.go:963`): it only indexed pages backed by files (`p.File() != nil`), so pages created via content adapters were invisible to `GetPage "p2"`.

The fix indexes every page by its path's base name using `p.PathInfo()` instead, which is available for both file-backed and adapter-created pages. Verified:
- `TestGetPageContentAdapterBaseIssue12561` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes
- Full `./hugolib` suite plus `resources/page`, `tpl/...`, `common/...`, and the rest of the testable packages pass
- The only remaining failures (`codegen`, `output/layouts`, one asciidoctor test) are pre-existing on the unmodified baseline, caused by missing network deps/external tools in the container
